---
title: "Explore"
subtitle: "Features along the canal, ordered from Georgetown to Cumberland."
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

featureDocument = FileAttachment("data/public/json/features.json").json()
featureTypes = ["all", ...Array.from(new Set(featureDocument.features.map(d => d.feature_type))).sort()]

viewof selectedType = Inputs.select(featureTypes, {label: "Feature type", value: "all"})

visibleFeatures = featureDocument.features.filter(d => selectedType === "all" || d.feature_type === selectedType)

Inputs.table(
  visibleFeatures.map(d => ({
    mile: d.mile_end == null ? d.mile : `${d.mile}–${d.mile_end}`,
    name: d.name,
    type: d.feature_type.replaceAll("_", " "),
    latitude: d.latitude,
    longitude: d.longitude
  })),
  {
    columns: ["mile", "name", "type", "latitude", "longitude"],
    header: {mile: "Mile", name: "Name", type: "Type", latitude: "Latitude", longitude: "Longitude"},
    rows: 20,
    sort: "mile"
  }
)
```

Coordinates for access points come from the C&O Canal Association reference.
Coordinates for milepost-only locks and recreation features are derived from the
canonical towpath geometry. They are suitable for exploration and analysis, not
turn-by-turn navigation.
